runs.answer:
The total revenue in Q3 2025 was $1,783,489.61.

caveats: - The query filters for orders with status 'completed' and timestamps in Q3 2025 (July 1 to September 30, 2025), which aligns with the definition of Q3. - Both queries returned the same result, confirming consistency in revenue calculation. - The result excludes cancelled orders and refunds, as the filter on 'completed' status ensures only finalized orders are included. - The data is limited to 5001 rows, but no indication of data truncation or missing values was found in the result.
sql: SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_ts >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_ts < '2025-10-01' LIMIT 5001

SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) AS total_revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_ts >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_ts < '2025-10-01' LIMIT 5001

caveats: - The query filtered for order timestamps in the format '2025-12-%' and excluded NULL timestamps. - The result is a count of all orders, regardless of status (completed or cancelled). - The query returned only one row, indicating successful execution with no errors.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_ts LIKE '2025-12-%' AND NOT order_ts IS NULL LIMIT 5001
